title: Cats in a Cat Cafe in Japan Reacting to an Earthquake - 994393
summary: A one-minute clip from a cat cafe in Japan where sleeping cats wake and look around just before an earthquake begins shaking the room.
why: Commenters use it in earthquake threads as an anecdote that animals may sense tremors seconds before humans, and occasionally as a joke about cat alarms.

quote.text: you can clearly see the cats get alerted to something ~10 seconds before the shaking starts
